title: Nonempty action serialization
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every action of a one-work-tape binary Turing machine with state set $\\{0,\\dots,n\\}$, the serialization of the action has length at least $1$.
hypotheses_covered: An action with one work tape, binary alphabet, and state set $\\{0,\\dots,n\\}$
replaced: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every transition action of a one-work-tape binary Turing machine with state set $\{0,\dots,n\}$, the canonical serialization of the action (the two-bit input-head move, followed by the encodings of the work-tape write, the work-head move, the output emission and the successor state) has length at least $1$.
